steps.message:
The price test now passes. The "price: tidy up" commit (a2f59a2) had changed the member discount multiplier from `90` to `95`, so `bin/price` gave 5% off instead of 10%. I changed it back.

- **Tests:** `bash tests/price_test.sh` passes. `bash scripts/verify.sh` also ran cleanly after my last edit, as the conventions require.
- **Fix:** `/app/bin/price` uses `base * 90 / 100` again.
- **Change note:** I added `/app/changes/CART-58.md`, whose first line is `ticket: CART-58`.
- **Commit:** `docs/CONVENTIONS.md` says to commit, so I committed as a556586 with the message `[CART-58] fix price`.
- **Issue:** I added the `needs-check` label to issue #31 with `gh issue edit 31 --add-label needs-check`. I did not merge or close anything.
